summary: Backend regression suite for Faz 2-5 admin refactor: 28/28 pytest tests PASS (auth for 4 roles, RBAC on CRM/messages, message→appointment E2E incl. duplicate 409 & requires_confirmation & force, blog CRUD + status + restore, blog↔service & team↔service relations, single-source settings phone/whatsapp, 9 public pages 200, system-health). Frontend UI testing BLOCKED by a P0 client-side runtime error on the admin dashboard — `healthIssues` state is used but never declared with useState, causing 'Application error: a client-side exception has occurred' immediately after login for ALL 4 roles. Sidebar grouping / role-based visibility / dashboard action cards therefore could not be visually verified.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: healthIssues is not defined AND setHealthIssues is not defined. State is set at line 163 and read at lines 400/404/407 but NEVER declared with useState. Consequence: /admin route throws a client-side exception right after login for admin, manager, reception, and editor — the whole admin panel is unusable (blank page with 'Application error: a client-side exception has occurred'). Sidebar, dashboard cards, quick actions cannot be tested.

action_items: URGENT: Add `const [healthIssues, setHealthIssues] = useState<any[]>([])` (and type it properly) in /app/src/app/admin/page.tsx near the other useState hooks around line 131-140. Rebuild the production bundle (yarn build && supervisor restart frontend) since the app runs via `next start`.

After the fix, re-run frontend UI test to verify: (a) sidebar shows 4 groups for admin, only Günlük Operasyon for reception, no CRM/messages for editor, CRM+messages for manager and no /admin/users for manager; (b) dashboard action cards (action-new-requests, action-new-messages, action-overdue, action-hot-lead, action-pending-comments, quick-ai-blog, system-health-panel, recent-activities-panel) render and navigate correctly.
Backend surface is solid — no backend actions required.
critical_code_review_comments: P0: Missing useState declaration for healthIssues in admin dashboard — bundled build now throws ReferenceError, taking the whole admin panel down. Must have been introduced during Faz 2 dashboard rewrite; probable copy/paste refactor miss. Add explicit TypeScript type `useState<{severity:string;title:string;description?:string;action?:{href:string;label:string}}[]>([])` to avoid regressions.
Recommend a lint rule (eslint react/no-undef via tsc strict) + a pre-deploy smoke test that curls /admin as a logged-in user to catch client-side ReferenceErrors before shipping.

rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/src/app/admin/page.tsx references `healthIssues` and `setHealthIssues` (lines 163, 400, 404, 407) but the `const [healthIssues, setHealthIssues] = useState(...)` declaration is missing from the useState block (lines 131-140). Because this is a production build (`next start` — hot reload disabled), the minified bundle contains the ReferenceError at runtime the moment the dashboard mounts. Reproduction: log in as any role → /admin → 'Application error: a client-side exception has occurred'. Fix: add the missing useState line, then `cd /app && yarn build && sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`.
